decisions.reason: As a recent black-finish line extension with likely low carrying cost and high overlap with the existing drainage portfolio, it is worth keeping while demand uncertainty resolves despite its limited website prominence.
Its dedicated webpage suggests a stronger commercial commitment, and as a close fit with modern shower installation trends it remains a valuable option to keep open for another year.

This pump-assisted solution appears more specialized and potentially costlier to support, so exit risk is higher, but after only one year the firm would still likely wait for clearer evidence before abandoning it.

A tileable floor drain with its own page sits close to the firm's core metal drainage capabilities, making it a relatively low-risk option to continue offering while the market response becomes clearer.

The stainless steel design grate is a modest, design-led portfolio extension with visible market support on the website, so the firm would likely retain it unless early sales proved clearly disappointing.
